verdict.rationale: Codegen gives several first-party ways to see what an agent is doing. The Agent Run Logs API exposes the agent's thought process, tool usage and execution flow, and the CLI/TUI lets you browse agents and view runs. Traces surface in the web UI, and agents report progress in Slack. Run states such as paused/resumed imply status tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live/streaming updates (as opposed to retrieving logs after the fact), a documented current-status field or values for runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
